mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as capital costs remain suppressed.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS) combined with accommodative monetary policy (low FEDFUNDS) amplifies equity valuations through higher earnings expectations and lower discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint effect of RSAFS > 400,000 and FEDFUNDS < 0.25% fails to produce positive returns in >60% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 95) signals manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand for housing and associated economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of periods when HOUST > 700, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing output decline (INDPRO < 95) reduces industrial capacity utilization and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market (PAYEMS growth) combined with robust consumer spending (RSAFS) increases disposable income and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint effect of PAYEMS > 133,000 and RSAFS > 400,000 fails to produce positive returns in >60% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.1pp in 3 months) increases cost of capital and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1 in 3 months, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.
